Option A is the more likely relationship. I answered from the known biology of this dataset and did not run any analysis on `flow.csv`.

The dataset looks like the Sachs et al. flow cytometry data on phosphoproteins and phospholipids. In the accepted signalling network for that data, PIP3 activates Akt (measured here as `pakts473`). PIP3 recruits Akt to the cell membrane, where it gets phosphorylated, so the effect runs from PIP3 to `pakts473` and not the other way round.

ANSWER: A
